EXCLUDED 'New Brand Arrivals' dropdown (Koinor, Exquisite Rugs, Gantri, Phase, Pieces, etc.) - brand rollups, not new-arrivals-by-category. EXCLUDED orphan collections found only via sitemap grep, never linked in any nav menu (checked the full homepage + /collections/new page source for links to each, found none): new-dining-tables, new-office-furniture, new-wallpaper, new-traditionalist, new-traditionalist-bedroom, new-traditionalist-living-room, new-traditionalist-dining-room (the 'New Traditionalist' family is a decor-style/trend collection name, not a 'recently added' listing, and is unlinked from navigation - doubly excluded). No robots.txt Claude-disallow; no WAF; all access via tier-1 direct HTTP fetch + Searchspring API, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed.
